caption: The drawing contains a symmetrical arrangement of geometric and symbolic shapes against a light parchment-like background. At the top center is a stylized yellow cross outlined in red with blue detailing and yellow rays emanating behind it. Below the cross is a bow shape with four blue-outlined, elongated loops filled with yellow and red dots, with a circular center displaying a star motif in yellow and red. Extending outward from either side are yellow wing-like shapes accented at the ends with red teardrop forms. Below the bow and wings is a large circular medallion containing a central blue ring surrounded by alternating triangular and petal-like shapes in yellow, blue, and red, creating a radiating, symmetrical pattern. The overall color palette consists of yellow, red, blue, and small touches of green, all placed on a lightly textured, aged beige background.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
